meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Cross-checked ready-first provider selection, bounded cooldown and native tool routing against the updated runtime and observability docs. Protected files remain scoped to PHP.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the owner constructor authorization, CSRF and session-bound public download grant against the authentication guides and actual guest/owner fixtures.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the downloaded file resolver and schema field against the source contracts for product orders and payments. This route uses the authored page publication and enquiry grant.

content.review_note: Checked the campaign entitlement route, authored settings and protected storage references against the content and storage guides. The dashboard uses a separate one-query audit projection.

foundation.review_note: Compared the fixed audit bridge, PDO cleanup and original timestamp parser with the storage guide. The private download directory and revision-aware entitlement remain documented.

google-tags.review_note: Compared the updated integration and provider examples with the Google reporting and analytics contracts, and cross-reviewed native download links against the frontend skill.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the front-controller and Apache path guards, private resolution and upload errors with the shared request-boundary documentation.

interface.review_note: Compared the storefront count states with the admin guide and the private download and enquiry controls with their authored layouts.

mail.review_note: Reviewed dashboard and authored controller paths against the mail guide. The existing campaign enquiry receipt and Inbox projection are preserved.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Reviewed the independent private download storage against the existing owner Media Library, header image and deletion documentation. Download files keep their own private root.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the dashboard counters and unavailable state with the Reports guide. Owner Pages and Inbox guidance still describes the authored enquiry and protected download controls.

public-mcp.review_note: Cross-checked the dashboard and authored page map entries with public MCP and A2UI. The storefront count remains owner analytics through the authenticated data bridge.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the fixed authenticated storefront count alongside Checkout and campaign controls. It reads the audit table independently of checkout writes and entitlement handling.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the regenerated maps and CI with authored campaign downloads present. The MySQL and MariaDB suites include the direct storefront SELECT and authenticated bridge regression.
